He later chaired 1 Global Capital, which offered financing to small businesses. In 2024, he was sentenced to five years in prison after pleading guilty to conspiracy to commit securities fraud at the lending company.

long_biography.plain_text:
Magazine owner Carl Ruderman delegated much of the editorial work at High Society while selecting Gloria Leonard, an adult-film actress, as its publisher. Leonard became the publication's public face, while editorial director Richard Barraclough managed its content. Ruderman expanded Drake Publishers, a company associated with textbooks, into a much broader publishing operation.

At Universal, the publisher of Elite Traveler, he gave executive Doug Gollan broad authority over daily operations but monitored profitability and advertising sales. He knew the sales staff's compensation arrangements, discussed business with employees during office visits and rewarded strong performance with bonuses. The magazine relied principally on advertising revenue and was distributed free to readers.
